outcome: false positive rates of elevated cord blood TSH levels
cohort: The study included 51,251 live newborn babies born at Fernandez Hospital, Hyderabad, India between January 2019 and December 2023.
finding: The prevalence of congenital hypothyroidism was 1.4 per 1000 live births in the study population, with maternal anaemia identified as a significant predictor for true positive CH cases.
mod_finding: Babies born by vaginal delivery had higher cord TSH levels than those born by lower segment caesarean section.
cross-section timing: At birth (for cord blood sample collection)
